### Reflection load recipe (required - plain `Assembly.LoadFrom` fails)

```powershell
$stage = "C:\md3-stage"
Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.nuget\packages" -Recurse -Filter "MacroDeck.*.dll" |
  Where-Object { $_.FullName -match "3\.0\.0-beta\.14" -and $_.FullName -match "net10\.0" } |
  ForEach-Object { Copy-Item $_.FullName $stage -Force }
Copy-Item "$env:USERPROFILE\.nuget\packages\serilog\4.4.0\lib\net10.0\Serilog.dll" $stage -Force   # Plugin.Serilog needs Serilog 4.4.0.0

$map=@{}; Get-ChildItem $stage -Filter *.dll | ForEach-Object { $map[[IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($_.FullName)]=$_.FullName }
$busy=New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList      # re-entrancy guard: satellite probing recurses forever without it
$res={ param($ctx,$args)
  $n=(($args.Name) -split ",")[0]
  if($busy.Contains($n)){ return $null }
  [void]$busy.Add($n)
  try { if($map.ContainsKey($n)){ return [System.Runtime.Loader.AssemblyLoadContext]::Default.LoadFromAssemblyPath($map[$n]) }; return $null }
  catch { return $null } finally { [void]$busy.Remove($n) }
}
$null=[System.Runtime.Loader.AssemblyLoadContext]::Default.add_Resolving($res)
Get-ChildItem $stage -Filter *.dll | ForEach-Object { [System.Runtime.Loader.AssemblyLoadContext]::Default.LoadFromAssemblyPath($_.FullName).GetExportedTypes() }
```

### Load notes


### How to read this document

- Every type gets a `### Type.FullName` heading followed by indented member lines.
- `FIELDS:` / `PROPERTIES:` / `EVENTS:` / `CONSTRUCTORS:` / `METHODS:` are DeclaredOnly - a member appears exactly once, under its declaring type. Walk `base=` to find inherited members.
- `{ get; init }` means an init-only setter (object-initializer only). `{ get }` is read-only.
- `NO PUBLIC ACCESSOR` means the member exists but is not public - see Gotchas.
- Types are `record` types: every `UIx` record also carries compiler-generated `<Clone>$`, `EqualityContract`, `PrintMembers`, `Equals`/`GetHashCode`/`ToString` and `op_Equality`/`op_Inequality`. Those are listed but not interesting.

## Gotchas

Everything below is verified against the beta.14 metadata. Several of these contradict the "obvious" reading of a type name and will cost you a compile error if you guess.

### 1. `UiValue` and `UiValue<T>` are two different types with the same name

This is the single biggest trap in the whole SDK.

- ``MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.UiValue`` is a **static class** (`IsAbstract=True, IsSealed=True`) holding four **generic factory methods**. It has no state and is not the value type.
- ``MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.UiValue`1`` is a **`readonly struct`**.

```csharp
UiValue<string> a = UiValue.Of("hello");   // via the static class, T inferred
UiValue<string> b = UiValue.From(() => Get()); // Func<T>
UiValue<string> c = UiValue.Optional(() => UiValue.None<string>()); // Func<UiValue<T>>
UiValue<string> d = UiValue.None<string>();
UiValue<string> e = "hello";               // implicit operator
```

There is **no public constructor**. `UiValue<T>`'s only ctor is `internal .ctor(T constant, Func<T> compute, Func<UiValue<T>> computeOptional, bool hasValue)`. Never write `new UiValue<string>(...)`.

### 2. `UiBinding<T>` — the constructor, `Value` and `CanWrite` are all `internal`

This is the biggest correction to the assumed shape. The public surface of ``MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.UiBinding`1`` is **nothing but `Equals`, `GetHashCode`, `ToString`, `op_Equality`, `op_Inequality`**.

Full-visibility dump:

```
[private]  MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.UiValue<T> _value
[private]  System.Action<T> _set
[private]  .ctor(MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.UiValue<T> value, System.Action<T> set)   <-- private, not public
[internal] MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.UiBinding<T> Create(UiValue<T> value, Action<T> set)
[internal] MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.UiValue<T> Value { get; }        <-- internal getter
[internal] bool CanWrite { get; }                            <-- internal getter
[internal] void Write(T value)
```

So `binding.Value` and `binding.CanWrite` **will not compile** from a plugin. The only supported construction path is ``MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.Bind``:

```csharp
Bind.To(state)              // To<T>(UiState<T> state) -> UiBinding<T>   two-way
Bind.ReadOnly(value)        // ReadOnly<T>(UiValue<T> value)             one-way, CanWrite=false
Bind.Custom(get, set)       // Custom<T>(Func<T> get, Action<T> set)    fully manual
```

`Bind` itself is a `static` class. Note `UiBinding<T>` is **also a struct**, so copying it copies the delegate pair.

### 3. `UiText` is a struct whose constructor is `private`

Confirmed struct (`IsValueType=True`, `IsSealed=True`), but you cannot `new` it — the ctor is `private .ctor(UiValue<LocalizedText> value)`.

The factory surface is slightly larger than expected:

```csharp
UiText.Of(string literal)                              // Of(string)
UiText.Of(LocalizedString localized)                   // Of(LocalizedString)
UiText.From(Func<string> compute)                      // From(Func<string>)
UiText.FromLocalized(Func<LocalizedString> compute)    // FromLocalized(Func<LocalizedString>)
UiText.None()
UiText.Optional(Func<UiText> compute)
```

Plus **four** implicit conversions, not two:

```csharp
implicit operator UiText(string literal)
implicit operator UiText(LocalizedString localized)
implicit operator UiText(LocalizedText text)
implicit operator UiText(UiValue<string> value)
```

Note the asymmetry that bites: `UiText`'s backing field is `UiValue<MacroDeck.Localization.LocalizedText>`, but there is an implicit conversion **from** `UiValue<string>`. `UiText.Value` is `internal`; only `UiText.IsDeclared` is a public getter. `TryEvaluate(out LocalizedText text)` is public.

### 4. `UiValue<T>.IsDeclared` is `internal`

Only public members of ``UiValue`1`` are `Equals`, `GetHashCode`, `ToString`, `op_Implicit`, `op_Equality`, `op_Inequality`. `bool IsDeclared { get; }` is `internal`. `TryEvaluate(out T)` is `internal` too. If you need to branch on "was a value actually supplied", you cannot ask the value type — ask the surrounding `UiElement` instead.

### 5. Internal interfaces leak into every `implements` list

These appear on the `implements=` line of many types but are **not public and not enumerable**:

- ``MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.IUiInputElement`` (member `bool CanWriteValue`)
- ``MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.IUiInputContainerElement``
- ``MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.IUiRepeatElement``
- ``MacroDeck.Ui.Runtime.Internal.IUiTrackedState``
- ``MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.UiViewException`` is public, but ``MacroDeck.Ui.Runtime.Internal.UiPropertyCell``, ``.UiSyncRoot`` are not

Consequence: you can **never** write `is IUiInputElement x` or type a variable as `IUiRepeatElement`. Use `UiInput<T>` / `UiRepeat<TItem>` / `UiContainer` instead.

### 6. Two types called `UiView`-ish, and `UiView`'s useful members are internal

`MacroDeck.Ui.Runtime.UiView` is a sealed class. Public: `Revision`, `PendingWorkCount`, `Surface`, `Tree`, `Batch()`, `Dispatch(UiEvent)`, `DrainPatches()`, `WhenIdleAsync(ct)`, `Dispose()`. **`IsDisposeRequested` and `SyncRoot` have no public accessor.** Its statics (`FindShadow`, `HandlersFor`, `Rebuild`) are internal.

### 7. `UiState<T>` — `Peek()` vs `Value`, and an internal attach hook

`UiState<T>` (sealed class) public members are exactly:

```csharp
T        Value { get; set; }    // not a UiValue<T> - a plain T
void     Set(T value)
T        Peek()
.ctor(T initialValue)
.ctor(T initialValue, IEqualityComparer<T> comparer)
```

`System.Action<UiView> ViewAttached { get; }` is **internal**. There is no ambient/static "current view" accessor on `UiState<T>`; you get a `UiView` by injecting it via DI and passing it to `Bind.To(state)`.

`UiAsyncState<T>` is a different shape entirely: `.ctor(Func<CancellationToken, Task<T>> load, T initialValue)`, `Value` (**get only**), `IsLoading`, `Error`, `Peek()`, `Reload()`. There is **no `Set`** — it is reload-driven, not writable.

### 8. `UiLength.Cell` is a `double` = 120, and `UiLength` is a class, not a struct

`MacroDeck.Ui.Components.UiLength` is a sealed **class** (record) with `{ get; set; }` `double Basis`, `Nullable<double> MaxOfCell`, `Nullable<double> MaxOfCross`. `const double UiLength.Cell = 120`. Factories: `OfBasis(double)`, `OfBasis(double, double maxOfCross)`, `Capped(double basis, double referenceExtent)`, plus `implicit operator UiLength(double)`. The name suggests a length primitive; it is a two-axis responsive sizing descriptor.

### 9. `UiIcons` is a static class of `string` constants, and two of its members are not constants

Most of ``MacroDeck.Ui.Components.UiIcons`` is `public const string` (`X = "x"`, `Bell = "bell"`, `Version1`…). But:

- ``System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<string> Version1`` — a `static readonly` list, **not** a `const string`. Its name looks like a version number; it is a list of icon names.
- ``System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<string> WellKnown`` — also a list.
- ``public static int? VersionOf(string name)`` — returns **nullable**, so `null` is a legitimate result meaning "icon unknown". Unwrap it.

### 10. Namespaces do not match their assembly

- ``MacroDeck.Plugin.Analyzers.IconMediaTypes`` is compiled into **MacroDeck.Plugin.Protocol**, not into the analyzers assembly. If you are reading the analyzer package to find it, you will not.
- All of ``MacroDeck.Ui.*`` (Components, Config, Dsl, Previews, Runtime) is in **MacroDeck.Ui.dll**, and all of ``MacroDeck.Ui.Model.*`` is in **MacroDeck.Ui.Model.dll**. There is no ``MacroDeck.Ui.Model.dll`` type in ``MacroDeck.Ui.dll`` and no reverse.
- Surface attributes that look like SDK types (``UiSurfaceKinds``, ``UiConfigSurfaceAttributes``, ``UiPatchOperations``) live in **MacroDeck.Ui.Model.Surfaces** / **.Patches**, *not* in ``MacroDeck.Sdk.Ui``. `MacroDeck.Sdk.Ui` contains only 12 types (including `UiResourceErrorCode`, `ModalDefinition`, `ModalResult<T>`, `IUiInteractions`).

### 11. Two `UiResourceErrorCode`-style enums, and almost nothing else is an enum

There are only **3** enums in the entire UI stack — `MacroDeck.Sdk.Ui.UiResourceErrorCode`, `MacroDeck.Ui.Config.UiWidgetAppearanceFields`, `MacroDeck.Ui.Runtime.UiDispatchOutcome`. Everything else that looks like an enum is a static class of `string` or `int` constants. Notably `UiWidgetAppearanceFields` is a `[Flags]`-style bitfield stored as `int` (`All = 63`), not a `System.Enum`, so you must combine with `|`.

### 12. Version numbers are `const int` and disagree with each other

- `UiModelVersions.Minimum = 3`, `UiModelVersions.Current = 4`
- `ProtocolVersions.Minimum = 1`, `Current = 3`, `LocalizedDescriptors = 3`
- `PluginManifest.SupportedManifestVersion = 1`

`UiModelVersions` (model schema) and `ProtocolVersions` (wire protocol) are unrelated counters with overlapping numbers. Do not compare a UI model version against a protocol version.

### 13. The `[Obsolete]` attributes are compiler-generated, not real deprecations

Every record type's parameterless copy constructor carries:

```
[Obsolete("Constructors of types with required members are not supported in this version of your compiler.")]
```

That is emitted by Roslyn for `record` types that have `required` members. It is **not** a deprecation signal, and it appears on ~200 DTO/callback types. Conversely, there is **no** genuinely deprecated public member in this build — `MacroDeck.Sdk.Deprecation` (4 types) is about plugin *migration* status, not `ObsoleteAttribute`.

Practical effect on `MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl`: `UiElement`, `UiLeaf`, `UiContainer`, `UiInput<T>`, `UiInputContainer<T>` all carry `[RequiredMember]`, and their **public parameterless ctors are marked obsolete from the consumer's compiler**. Most concrete inputs (`UiStringInput`, `UiNumberInput`, …) expose `public .ctor()` — that is what you use with object initializers.

### 14. `NO PUBLIC ACCESSOR` also appears on compiler-generated record members

`System.Type EqualityContract { protected get; }` on every record base, and `IReadOnlyList<string> DeclaredEvents { }`, `bool HasValidation { }` on `UiInput<T>`, are internal/protected. These are not API you can call — but their presence tells you the type is a record with structural equality, so `==` on two `UiInput<T>` values compares **all** properties, and a `Func<>` delegate member compares by target+method, not by result.

### 15. `UiRepeat<TItem>.Template` takes the item **and** the key

```csharp
Func<TItem, string, UiElement> Template { get; init; }   // (item, key)
Func<TItem, string>          KeySelector { get; init; }
UiValue<IReadOnlyList<TItem>> Items { get; init; }
```

`Template` is two-parameter, and both `Template` and `KeySelector` are **`Func<>` delegates, not `UiValue`**. They are `required` on the record, so the compiler forces you to supply them. Naming suggests a single-argument template; it is not.

### 16. `UiText.None()` vs `UiValue.None<T>()` vs `Optional`

`None()` means "declared as explicitly empty". `Optional(Func<UiValue<T>>)` means "may be absent; the compute returns a `UiValue<T>` that may itself be `None`". They are not interchangeable, and `UiText.Optional(Func<UiText>)` has a different signature from `UiValue.Optional<T>(Func<UiValue<T>>)`.

### 17. `UiOptionsInput<T>` inherits from `UiInput<T>`, so `Binding` is `UiBinding<T>` — but options are `IReadOnlyList<UiOption>`

`UiChoiceInput`, `UiAutocompleteInput`, `UiDynamicChoiceInput`, `UiWidgetTargetInput` all derive from ``UiOptionsInput<string>``; `UiMultiSelectInput` derives from ``UiOptionsInput<IReadOnlyList<string>>``. The options payload itself is `UiValue<IReadOnlyList<UiOption>>` from ``MacroDeck.Ui.Config.Options.UiOption``. Its `Binding` type is `UiBinding<string>` (single) or `UiBinding<IReadOnlyList<string>>` (multi) — the multi-select binding is **not** a `UiBinding<string>`, so a helper that takes `UiBinding<string>` will not accept it.

### 18. Silently-wrong defaults

- ``UiComponentModifiers`` gesture numbers are absolute and small: `DimOpacity = 0.4`, `GestureSlop = 0.04`, `SwipeMinDistance = 0.2`, `SwipeMaxDurationMs = 500`, `GestureThrottleMs = 100`, `PointerMoveIntervalMs = 16`, `PointerMoveMaxSamples = 256`, `TapMaxDurationMs = 400`. `PointerMoveIntervalMs = 16` is ~60 fps and will sample aggressively on a deck.
- ``UiResponsiveSelection.Tolerance = 0.0001`` — a near-exact float compare on breakpoint selection.
- ``LocalizationResolver.MaxArgumentDepth = 4`` — interpolation args nested deeper than 4 are silently not resolved.
- ``LocalizationDefaults.Culture = "en"`` is the default when the host supplies nothing.
- ``UiCanonicalJson.MaxDepth = 32`` — deeper payloads are rejected, not truncated.
- ``MacroDeck.Sdk.MacroDeckPlatform`` is a bitfield stored as `int`: `Windows = 1`, `MacOS = 2`, `Linux = 4`, `All = 7`. It is an enum, so you *can* use `|`, but it is not `[Flags]`-annotated in the source, so the analyzer will not suggest it.

### 19. `ModalResult<T>` and `ShowModalAsync<T>`

`IUiInteractions.ShowModalAsync<T>(string originClientId, ModalDefinition modal, CancellationToken)` returns `Task<ModalResult<T>>`. `ModalResult<T>` is a record with `Value { get; init; }` and `Cancelled { get; init; }`, built via the **static factories on the non-generic** `ModalResult` class: `ModalResult.FromValue<T>(T value)` and `ModalResult.FromCancellation<T>()`. Checking `Value` on a cancelled result is a bug — check `Cancelled`.

### 20. Members whose type differs from what the name suggests

| Member | Name suggests | Actual type |
|---|---|---|
| ``MacroDeck.Ui.Config.UiInput<T>.MaxLength`` | `int` | ``UiValue<int>`` |
| ``MacroDeck.Ui.Config.UiInput<T>.MinConstraint`` / `MaxConstraint` | `Min`/`Max` double | ``UiValue<double>``, **internal getters** |
| ``MacroDeck.Ui.Config.UiOptionsInput<T>.CacheSeconds`` | `int` | ``UiValue<int>`` |
| ``MacroDeck.Ui.Config.UiOptionsInput<T>.FilterDebounceMilliseconds`` | name matches | ``UiValue<int>``, but the JSON key is `filterDebounceMs` (`UiConfigProperties.FilterDebounceMs`) — **name mismatch between C# and wire** |
| ``MacroDeck.Ui.Model.Surfaces.UiWidgetSurfaceAttributes.Data`` | string data | `string`, whereas config surfaces use `UiConfigSurfaceAttributes.WidgetData` = "widgetData" |
| ``MacroDeck.Ui.Config.UiInput<T>.VisibleWhen`` | `bool` | ``UiValue<MacroDeck.Ui.Config.UiVisibleWhen>`` |
| ``MacroDeck.Plugin.Hosting.Integrations.HostApis.*.Logging`` | `ILogger` | `void` (a builder-style `Logging` method) |
| ``MacroDeck.Ui.Components.UiView.PendingWorkCount`` | count | `int` |

Also: `UiWidgetAppearanceKeys.BorderStyle = "style"` and `UiWidgetAppearanceKeys.BorderColor = "color"` — **generic short names**, unlike every sibling key which is prefixed (`backgroundColor`, `labelColor`, `accentColor`, `fontSize`). They are the exact strings for the nested border object.

### 21. Frozen constants you must not re-type by hand

The full set is in Appendix B. The ones most likely to cause a silent wire mismatch:

```
UiConfigSurfaceAttributes.WidgetData   = "widgetData"
UiConfigSurfaceAttributes.EntryPoint   = "entryPoint"
UiConfigSurfaceAttributes.Parameters   = "parameters"
UiConfigSurfaceAttributes.MaskedSecretValue = "$masked"
UiSurfaceKinds.Config="config"  Widget="widget"  Dialog="dialog"  Preview="preview"
UiSurfaceKinds.Folder="folder"  DeveloperPreview="developer-preview"  ScreenSaver="screensaver"
UiPatchOperations.SetProperties="set-properties"  InsertNode="insert-node"
UiPatchOperations.RemoveNode="remove-node"  ReplaceNode="replace-node"  MoveNode="move-node"
UiConfigEntryPoints.WidgetConfig="widget-config"  ActionConfig="action-config"
UiConfigEntryPoints.IntegrationConfig="integration-config"
UiConfigEntryPoints.FolderViewConfig="folder-view-config"
UiConfigEntryPoints.ScreenSaverConfig="screensaver-config"
UiComponents.* = "ui.stack" "ui.text" "ui.image" "ui.slider" "ui.button" ... (dotted, 22 total)
UiMacroDeckComponents.DynamicText="macrodeck.dynamic-text"  ClockDial="macrodeck.clock-dial"
UiMacroDeckComponents.ProgressBar="macrodeck.progress-bar"  ProgressText="macrodeck.progress-text"
LocalizationScope.MacroDeck="macrodeck"  LocalizationScope.PluginPrefix="plugin:"
LocalizedTextJsonConverter.Marker="$localized"  ScopeProperty="scope" KeyProperty="key"
UiProgressReferenceJsonConverter.Marker="$progress"  PositionProperty="positionMs"
UiTimeReferenceJsonConverter.Marker="$time"  ZoneProperty="zone"
PluginHostOptions.SectionName="MacroDeck:Plugin"
PluginEnvironmentConfiguration.Prefix="MACRO_DECK_PLUGIN_"
ReservedPaths.Prefix="/_macrodeck"
```

Two different naming conventions coexist: ``UiComponents.*`` uses dots (`ui.text`) while every property key uses camelCase (`backgroundColor`) and every primitive type uses kebab-case (`dynamic-choice`, `keyboard-combo`). `UiStringInput.Type` is an **instance** `{ get }` property (not a `const`), returning "string".

### 22. What I could not enumerate

- **`MacroDeck.Plugin.Analyzers.dll`** (the Roslyn analyzer) was not loaded. It lives in `analyzers/dotnet/cs/`, not `lib/net10.0/`, and targets the compiler not the runtime. Its diagnostics are invisible from reflection. The one type it shares, ``MacroDeck.Plugin.Analyzers.IconMediaTypes``, is documented above because it is really compiled into `MacroDeck.Plugin.Protocol`.
- **ASP.NET Core types.** `Microsoft.AspNetCore`, `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Abstractions`, and their versions are referenced by `MacroDeck.Plugin.Hosting` signatures (`IPluginStartup.Configure`, `ConfigureServices`, `WebApplication`, `WebApplicationBuilder`) but are **not in the local NuGet cache** at a loadable path. Those ~10 members are marked `unresolved dependency: …` inline. Their *names* are correct; only the parameter types are unreadable. Load the `Microsoft.AspNetCore.App` shared framework to resolve them.
- **Non-public surface.** `GetExportedTypes()` covers public types only. Internal types such as ``MacroDeck.Ui.Runtime.Internal.*``, ``MacroDeck.Ui.Dsl.IUiInputElement`` and the concrete `UiPropertyCell`/`UiSyncRoot` are referenced by public signatures but have no entry of their own. Three were dumped by hand (Appendix A, full-visibility section).
- **Default parameter values that are `default(T)` of a non-trivial type** are emitted as `<default>` because the metadata blob is not readable via reflection. Any `= null` / `= false` / numeric default was resolved correctly.
- **XML doc comments** were not extracted; this document is metadata-only, so intent is not recorded — only shape.
